brief:
Gaza-based Hamas official Ghazi Hamad said the movement has made significant efforts to halt the war on Gaza, noting it has offered concessions and taken steps in coordination with Palestinian political factions, Shehab Wire reported. Hamad stated that the United States has the capacity to compel Israel to cease military operations.

Hamad criticized the international stance on the conflict, describing it as shameful. He indicated that Hamas has worked to align its positions with other Palestinian political parties in pursuit of a ceasefire.
